g.text: Boss theme for four main bosses and one hidden boss in a 1930s
cursed-island survival game. Slow ominous canon between a detuned
concertina and low strings; layers unlock per boss phase (phase 1
sparse, phase 2 adds choir-like synth pads, phase 3 full ensemble
with bell strikes on downbeats). For the hidden boss, strip to a
single detuned choir note and a heartbeat pulse. Muted teal-and-
brass palette mood, dread and reverence, never cartoonish. 140
seconds, seamless loop, no vocals. Deliver 48 kHz WAV plus OGG;
Full prompt: Eagle annotation and request.md
